Chapter 1232: 38: Controlling The Treasure Land (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 1232: Chapter 38: Controlling the Treasure Land (Subscription Requested)

Capital of Fierce Sun Country, Lin Yuan’s true form had gone to the newly emerged treasure ground, while the Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit guarded the other two first-class treasure grounds.

Thus, leaving only a manifestation in the capital’s royal residence, though by Lin Yuan’s power, even a manifestation was equivalent to a Peak Venerable.

“Galaxy, did you sweep through Fu Xu Venerate and other top-tier deities in the treasure ground? Is this true?” A message arrived, coming from the emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Even though the emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country had already received confirmed intelligence, and even watched video footage, he still found it hard to believe, so he personally came to inquire.

“Indeed, my power has just had a breakthrough.” Lin Yuan did not conceal it.

He was the core of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s royal family, inherently standing with the ancient country, his increasing power only strengthened the country’s foundation.

As for arousing envy? With Lin Yuan’s current strength, he could completely ignore these.

“Good, good, good.” The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was delighted, Galaxy Venerate displaying such overwhelming strength against the Strongest Venerable indicated that it was far more than just about the battle for a treasure ground.

It would also profoundly impact the long-term dynamics among the six ancient countries in the future.

With Lin Yuan being an existence far surpassing the Strongest Venerable, which of the other five ancient countries, including Da Fu Ancient Country, would dare to engage in high-intensity warfare with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country?

If they dare not enter warfare, they can only make concessions and retreat.

“Galaxy Venerate, you have truly surprised me.” The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan with great emotion.

He did not ask much about why Lin Yuan possessed such power; every strong person had their secrets, an aspect the ancient country never interfered with.

Lin Yuan smiled slightly, saying nothing.

“Are you aware of what the Strongest Venerables from Da Fu Ancient Country are calling you?” The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country couldn’t help but say.

“What?” Lin Yuan was quite curious.

In the treasure ground, he showed no mercy to the Peak Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country, even slaying Fu Xu Venerate, one of the Strongest Venerables.

“Invincible Venerable.” The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country clicked his tongue.

Even the proud Strongest Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country used such a title for Lin Yuan, indicating their total abandonment of any thought of contention.

Invincible Venerable, what does invincible mean?

It means absolute dominance and sweeping through all.

“Invincible Venerable?”

Lin Yuan understood in his heart.

In Chaos Void, there is talk of an Invincible Great Saint, where a certain supreme Great Saint would overwhelm all other supreme Great Saints, convincing them entirely, thus claiming the title of Invincible Great Saint.

But among the six ancient countries?

The so-called Invincible Great Saint equated to the Strongest Venerable of the six ancient countries.

An Invincible Great Saint in Chaos Void might be invincible, but within the six ancient countries, naturally, they cannot be considered invincible, for there remain opponents, with each ancestral heritage nurturing heirs who stand shoulder to shoulder with Invincible Great Saints as the Strongest Venerables.

And now, Lin Yuan’s strength made the Strongest Venerables of the six ancient countries despair, calling him Invincible Venerable with good reason.

“Galaxy, you’ve redefined what constitutes the limits of a Venerable.” The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country stated, noting that besides Da Fu Ancient Country, the other four ancient countries likewise intensely debated Galaxy Venerate.

“Venerable limits?” Lin Yuan mused, “Actually, I am far from reaching the limit.”

Currently, in terms of realm, Lin Yuan has indeed achieved perfection in Chaos Realm, but in other techniques, he still has substantial room for enhancement.

For example, the inheritance of “Infinite Void,” now Lin Yuan remains at the third level; though aspiring for the seventh level is improbable, he has considerable confidence in reaching the sixth level.

And from the third level to the sixth level, there lies the fourth and fifth levels.

Besides, the evolved Chaotic Taiji Dao currently also stands at the first tier, according to the many venerables of the six ancient countries in their comprehension of the path of chaotic evolution, the upper limit should be the third tier.

Lastly, Lin Yuan can also cultivate numerous thirteenth-tier inheritances in the treasure trove of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country to enhance his strength.

Thirteenth-tier inheritance requires plenty of merit, yet through this treasure ground contention, Lin Yuan predicts having earned massive ancient country merits.

“Cultivating thirteenth-tier inheritance is good, enhancing the path of chaotic evolution is better, all to prepare for achieving the thirteenth tier.” Lin Yuan knew clearly where his targets lay.

Secret techniques are branches.

Realm is fundamental.

Cultivating thirteenth-tier inheritance is also for experiencing thirteenth-tier power.

To better break through the cycle of time.

…..

“Galaxy, what’s the situation in the treasure ground?” inquired the emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

“All is under control.” Lin Yuan nodded.

The many Peak Venerables from Da Fu Ancient Country and the other four ancient countries, either died or fled, didn’t dare remain in the treasure ground.

What Lin Yuan needed to do next was to sequentially refine all the core pillars, and when the two-thousand-year treasure ground competition concluded, formally determine the rightful owner of the treasure ground.

“Red Flame Venerable mentioned the situation in the treasure ground to me; if it weren’t for you, Galaxy, our Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s chance of seizing this treasure ground would be slim, and even if successful, Xuanyin and Da Ling would harshly exploit us.”

The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country sighed deeply, “In this treasure ground struggle, Galaxy, your contributions were immense; without you, the situation wouldn’t be as it is now.”

“I think simply rewarding you for your merits is no longer sufficient to illustrate your importance, Lin Yuan.” The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan and said, “So, I have decided, once the ownership of the precious land is determined, it will be guarded by you, Galaxy. During your guardianship, all the treasures produced within the precious land will belong to you alone, without needing to be turned over to the Ancient Country.”

“As long as you remain, Galaxy, this precious land is yours. Regardless of whether I am on the throne or which emperor succeeds me, this fact cannot change.”

Lin Yuan was slightly taken aback upon hearing this.

Does the precious land completely belong to him?

It’s important to know that, let alone that this precious land is a top-tier one among first-class lands, even the most ordinary of the precious lands under the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s control require the guardians to hand over eighty to ninety percent of the rare treasures produced to the Ancient Country.

This is a rule set by the Ancient Country.

No one can defy it.

But now? The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country is almost half-giving this precious land to him?

“This is too valuable.” Lin Yuan shook his head. The value of a first-class precious land is equivalent to a money tree, and he is being easily given it?

Although Lin Yuan almost single-handedly took over this precious land, he knew very well that all of this was leveraged by the power of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Without the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, those Peak Venerables from other Ancient Countries wouldn’t be fighting him equally. If pushed to the limit, they could easily seek their ancestors.

It is precisely because of the presence of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country that the struggle is limited to below the ancestors, not reaching the level of needing the ancestors.

Had those Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country been forced to seek their ancestors, it would be a disgrace to the ancestors.

“Galaxy, you are underestimating your influence too much.” The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country said with a smile, “With you here, it’s not just about one precious land. In the future, which of the other five major Ancient Countries would dare to compete with our Fierce Sun Ancient Country? Your presence, Galaxy, will win countless benefits for our Fierce Sun Ancient Country. What is one precious land?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and thought, of course, one shouldn’t refuse a benefit given freely. Furthermore, his deterrent power is indeed significant, so he nodded and said, “Alright, I’ll accept it.”

The rare treasures nurtured by this first-class precious land involve the domain of time. Researching it may prove highly useful to him.

Moreover, even if it is not needed, as the sole controller of this precious land, Lin Yuan effectively monopolizes these rare treasures and can sell them at will.

“Hahaha, as for the merits of capturing this precious land, we can discuss them once the competition is completely over.” The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country said with a cheerful smile.

The final distribution of merit involves not only Lin Yuan but also the participation of other Peak Venerables from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Although these Peak Venerables are far less significant than Lin Yuan, since they participated, they will receive some merits, however small.

“Good.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Now, less than two hundred years remain until the two-thousand-year limit for the precious land contest.

“However, if in the future you, Galaxy, make a breakthrough in the realm of the ancestors, this precious land can be guarded by your descendants. But it will then be treated as a normal precious land, and eighty percent of the rare treasures produced must be handed over to the Ancient Country.”

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country seemed to suddenly remember something and immediately added.

“Naturally.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Turning over the rare treasures produced by the precious land to the Ancient Country not only involves sharing benefits but also gaining protection.

Lin Yuan’s power is absolutely invincible, even if he monopolizes all the rare treasures produced by the precious land, there will be no issues.

But what about the future? When Lin Yuan breaks through to the thirteenth rank and his descendants guard the precious land, they won’t have Lin Yuan’s power, and monopolizing all the precious land’s treasures isn’t a good thing.

Giving eighty percent of the rare treasures to the Ancient Country is equivalent to binding the Ancient Country to himself, making it safer.

At least with an eighty percent share of the treasures, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country will definitely make every effort to ensure this precious land isn’t disturbed by other Ancient Countries.

…

Within the precious land.

Lin Yuan continued to chat casually with Red Flame Venerable and other Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country for a while, then proceeded to refine more of the core pillars within the precious land.

Since beginning the aggressive takeover, Lin Yuan had only refined over a hundred core pillars, with more than half of the core pillars yet to be refined.

Buzz buzz buzz~

As each core pillar was refined by Lin Yuan.

A profoundly mysterious sense of control surged into his mind.

Refining the core pillars of the precious land allows for a certain degree of control over it.

Theoretically, refining all core pillars is equivalent to refining this precious land.

However, from the moment this newly born precious land emerged until now, many core pillars had been refined by the Peak Venerables of the six major Ancient Countries, and it had never been unified in refinement.

Soon.

All of the three gigantic core pillars, along with over three hundred ordinary core pillars, were completely refined by Lin Yuan.

In a split second, Lin Yuan’s mind soared to unprecedented heights, descending into the deepest part of the precious land—a place that former Peak Venerables had never reached and could only be accessed by refining all the core pillars.

“What is this?”

Lin Yuan looked around, his pupils slightly contracting.
